usage: conformer_conformations [-h] [--setup setup_file]
                               receptor_structure ligand_structure
                               lightdock_output glowworms

positional arguments:
  receptor_structure    receptor structures: PDB file or list of PDB files
  ligand_structure      ligand structures: PDB file or list of PDB files
  lightdock_output      lightdock output file
  glowworms             number of glowworms

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --setup setup_file, -setup setup_file, -s setup_file
                        Simulation setup file
